text: dsh-session-delete 是一款面向 DSH Web 客户端的会话管理插件，在会话标题栏加入删除按钮，并在侧栏会话菜单注入删除入口。它提供带有确认勾选框的删除对话框、运行中会话提示、agent 删除会话工具，并在删除后刷新会话列表。删除流程会清理会话日志、投影缓存及工作区记账；运行中的任务会先停止。适合需要从界面或 agent 清理错误、过期会话的用户。配置 DSH_HOME 可指定 DSH 数据目录，否则使用默认目录。

dsh-session-delete adds a header button and sidebar entry for deleting DSH sessions. A confirmation dialog warns about running sessions. Deletion removes logs, cache records, and workspace accounting; active work is stopped first. Agents can also delete sessions with a tool.

dsh-session-delete 的功能「界面删除会话」：在当前会话标题栏提供垃圾桶按钮，侧栏会话行菜单提供删除入口。点击后打开确认对话框，需勾选确认后才能提交删除。
dsh-session-delete 的功能「清理会话数据」：确认删除后移除会话日志目录、投影缓存记录及工作区和归档会话记账，检查日志目录已清除后才处理工作区记账。
dsh-session-delete 的功能「删除运行中的会话」：删除运行中的会话时先取消 agent 当前任务并等待其空闲，随后刷新会话状态并移除会话数据；界面会显示运行状态提醒。
dsh-session-delete 的功能「agent 会话删除工具」：注册 workbench_session_delete 工具，接收必填 sessionId（UUID 或 session-UUID），并返回删除结果或失败信息。
dsh-session-delete 的功能「删除后刷新列表」：界面删除成功后刷新侧栏会话列表；如果刚删除的是当前会话，则打开列表中的下一条会话。
dsh-session-delete 使用前须知：删除会永久移除会话日志、缓存和工作区记账；运行中任务会被取消，操作不可恢复。（src/index.js:233-268）

After deletion the client reloads; the edit-mode caller should verify with workbench_status or the session list.

Bothered by abandoned or mistyped conversations cluttering your sidebar? Ever tried editing your harness only to find the session history out of sync — with a corrupted session that just won't go away? This plugin has your back!

@pepsi-ai/dsh-plugin-session-delete README · dsh-plugin-session-delete：**Safely delete sessions from the DeepSeek Harness UI.** Adds a trash button at the top of the conversation and a "Delete session" item to the sidebar session-row "..." menu; clicking either opens a risk-consent dialog (checkbox required). On confirm, the session log, projection cache and workspace accounting are removed. Running sessions show a warning — if you still choose to delete, the session is stopped and then deleted. Works in the web, and is theoretically compatible with any web-shell-based client.
**Also adds an agent tool so agents can delete sessions.** Tool name: `workbench_session_delete`

@pepsi-ai/dsh-plugin-session-delete README · Features：- Trash button at the top of the conversation
- "Delete session" item injected into the sidebar session-row "..." menu
- `RiskConfirmation` risk-consent dialog: confirm is only enabled after ticking "I understand the consequences"
- Delete chain: session log + projection cache + workspace accounting (through the active storageDomain, so in-memory state and on-disk units stay consistent)
- `workbench_session_delete` tool: agents can delete sessions directly
